answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method with representative multi-head attention models on a broad range of tasks including sentence classification, machine translation, language modeling and text generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of abstracts with 3 major metrics: BLEU (uni-gram to 4-gram BLEU), METEOR, ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: To further illustrate the improvement of using diverse attention, we conduct human evaluation. Following , we give 50 test datapoints to experts (5 computer science students) and ask them to provide per-criterion judgments for the generated abstracts.
answer_4.guideline: Comparisons of the two methods from 4 aspects are shown in Table. The human judgment indicates that the repulsive attention improves both the structure and informativeness of generated abstracts significantly.
